article.title: Orders under rule 101 or rule 103 to be subject to the result or pending suit.
article.content: Every order made under rule 101 or rule 103 shall subject to the result of any suit that may be pending on the date of commencement of the proceeding in which such order, is made if in such suit the party against whom the order under rule 101 or rule 103 is made has sought to establish a right which he claims to the present possession of the property.
article.html:
104Orders under rule 101 or rule 103 to be subject to the result or pending suit.

Order 21, Rule 104

Every order made under rule 101 or rule 103 shall subject to the result of any suit that may be pending on the date of commencement of the proceeding in which such order, is made if in such suit the party against whom the order under rule 101 or rule 103 is made has sought to establish a right which he claims to the present possession of the property.

2 Ins. by s. 72, ibid. (w.e.f. 1-2-1977).
